docs.title: How to recover from a stuck PG in Ceph after OSD failure
docs.abstract: This article describes how to identify and recover placement groups (PGs) stuck in degraded, inconsistent, or peering state after an OSD failure.

docs.title: CephFS client eviction causes application hang with kernel client
docs.abstract: When a CephFS client is evicted by the MDS, applications using the kernel mount experience a hang rather than receiving an error.
